council: City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council
current_evidence: Bradford's 'What to submit with your planning application' page links 'The Bradford Local Validation List' to the local-requirements-all page, which lists 55 local requirements, plus nine type-specific checklists. Grokbot's URL is only the 'Major planning applications' checklist. No adoption or update date appears on any of these pages; the only date is the 'Copyright 2026' footer.

issues.detail: The Validation list URL is the 'Validation Checklist - Major Planning Application' page, one of nine type-specific checklists, not Bradford's local list. The council's list is the 'Local Requirements - All' page.
issues.evidence: Parent page: 'The Bradford Local Validation List' -> /local-requirements-all/; checklists for planning, major, householder, LBC, advert, LDC existing/proposed, prior approval agricultural/new dwellings

issues.detail: No app-type row covers about 25 of the 47 local requirements on the major checklist. Missing: Agricultural statement, Air quality assessment, Air quality - exposure assessment, Coal mining risk assessment (only under Householder), Crime Impact Statement, Daylight/sunlight assessment, Digital infrastructure statement (Grokbot read the page but made no row), Drawing/document register, Energy statement, Flood risk assessment (not under Full), Foul drainage assessment, Greenbelt assessment, Habitat regulations assessment / South Pennine Moors (only fragments in tab_items), Heritage statement (not under Full), Landscape and visual impact assessment and Landscape sensitivity and capacity assessment, Lighting assessment, Noise assessment, Structural survey, Town centre impact assessment, Town centre sequential test, Travel plan, Tree survey (only under Works to trees), Ventilation and extraction statement, Visual representations, Minerals working and Waste development additional requirements (the Minerals & waste row says 'none').
issues.evidence: Major checklist 'Local information requirements' items 1-47; local-requirements-all items 1-55

issues.detail: Type-specific checklists were not reflected. Householder misses existing/proposed elevations, floor plans, sections and levels, roof plans, CIL Form 1, Green belt assessment (householder), Tree survey and arboricultural impact assessment, and Habitat mitigation (annexe). Advertisement consent says 'none', but the source needs existing and proposed elevations and Advertisement plans. Listed building consent misses 'Detailed plans (listed building consent)'. Full planning has no elevations, floor plans, sections or levels, roof plan or parking plan. Parameter plan appears only under Outline.
issues.evidence: Householder checklist local items 1-11; Advertisement consent checklist: 'Existing and proposed elevations', 'Advertisement plans'

issues.detail: Three tree-survey items sit under 'Works to trees': Arboricultural Impact/Tree Survey, Block plan/Site plan, and an Arboricultural Method Statement labelled 'Schedule of works (listed building)'. All come from the Tree Survey page for planning applications near trees, not from tree works (TPO/conservation area) applications. The AMS is also mislabelled as a listed building schedule of works.
issues.evidence: 'An Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) will be required in all instances where the siting of development ... cannot be located outside Root Protection Areas'

issues.detail: Householder lists three items that are not on Bradford's householder checklist. Coal Mining Risk Assessment (householder is not listed), Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment (taken from the Landscape sensitivity and capacity assessment page) and a standalone Archaeological Desk-Based Assessment (only a sub-element of the Heritage Statement).
issues.evidence: Householder checklist local items: elevations, floor plans, sections/levels, roof plans, bat roost form, CIL, FRA (householder), green belt (householder), heritage (householder), tree survey, habitat mitigation (annexe)

issues.detail: 'Gypsy & Traveller information' under Full planning is not a Bradford requirement. The excerpt is a list of residential-type uses on the South Pennine Moors HRA page that need Policy SC8 recreational mitigation.
issues.evidence: 'Gypsies and traveller pitches Hotels, boarding or guest house (use class C1) ... Applications should comply with the requirements of Policy SC8 and provide mitigation for any recreational impacts on the South Pennine Moors SPA/SAC'

issues.detail: Many triggers contain no trigger. Several are just the page title and breadcrumb ('Local Requirements - Affordable Housing Statement | Bradford Council Bradford Council Planning and building control...'), for Affordable Housing, Surface Water Drainage, Residential Space Standards, Landscaping Scheme, SCI and Transport Assessment. Others are mid-sentence fragments: Contaminated Land is a footnote from the YALPAG guidance PDF; Ecological ends 'determine whether a bat survey is required'; Viability and Planning Obligations are the same cut-off sentence.
issues.evidence: Contaminated land excerpt: 'planning conditions. 1 Land Contamination Risk Management, Environment Agency, Oct 2020 2 Verification of Remediation of Land Contamination.'

issues.detail: Most tab_items are guidance links, policy context or page navigation, not requirements. They include the bat survey guidance PDFs and flow diagram, CIEEM/BCT/Froglife references, the 'Revised Bradford Statement of Community Involvement 2018 - 2023 (PDF)' link, 'Other pages in this section ... Stay Connected Sign up for email updates', the householder checklist page header, and roughly 13 'Policy-driven' fragments of South Pennine Moors SPA/SAC policy text.
issues.evidence: 'Consultation and pre-decision matters Revised Bradford Statement of Community Involvement 2018 - 2023 (PDF) Other pages in this section ... Stay Connected Sign up for email updates'

issues.detail: Outline, Full and LBC rows use generic or 'INFERRED' placement, even though Bradford publishes separate checklists for planning applications (full, outline, RM, S73), LDC existing, LDC proposed, prior approval for agricultural buildings and prior approval to dwellings. Reserved matters, Variation of condition, LDC and these prior approval types all show 'none' or one item without those checklists being checked.
issues.evidence: 'What to submit' page lists 9 checklists by application type

summary: Grokbot links Bradford's major-applications checklist rather than the 'Local Requirements - All' local list (neither is dated). More than half the local requirements are missing, tree-survey items are wrongly placed under Works to trees, the householder and advert checklists are misrepresented, and most triggers are page titles or fragments.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
